definitions.name: Land record
definitions.description: World atlas: one major land and its full design plan. Written once, never rewritten. Never playable, never drawn.

definitions.name: Land region record
definitions.description: World atlas: one region inside a land (identity for Run knowledge).

definitions.name: Route record
definitions.description: World atlas: a route joining gates of two lands; traversable or gated by a requirement.

definitions.name: Atlas revision
definitions.description: World atlas: one activated change (lands and routes added) with provenance and approval.
